options: Two or more substances combine to form one product
One substance breaks into two or more products
optionsAf: Twee of meer stowwe kombineer om een produk te vorm
Een stof breek in twee of meer produkte
items.explain: Synthesis: A + B → AB, for example hydrogen and oxygen forming water.
items.explainAf: Sintese: A + B → AB, byvoorbeeld waterstof en suurstof wat water vorm.

items.q: Calcium carbonate heats up and breaks into calcium oxide and carbon dioxide. Which type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Kalsiumkarbonaat word verhit en breek in kalsiumoksied en koolstofdioksied. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: One compound breaks into two simpler products, so it is a decomposition reaction.
items.explainAf: Een verbinding breek in twee eenvoudiger produkte, dus is dit ’n ontbindingsreaksie.

items.q: Zinc is placed in copper sulfate solution and copper is deposited. Which type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Sink word in kopersulfaatoplossing geplaas en koper word afgeset. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: Zinc is more reactive than copper, so it displaces copper from the solution.
items.explainAf: Sink is reaktiewer as koper, so dit verplaas koper uit die oplossing.

items.q: What is needed for combustion (burning) of a fuel with oxygen?
items.qAf: Wat is nodig vir verbranding van ’n brandstof met suurstof?
items.explain: The fire triangle: fuel, oxygen and heat to start the reaction.
items.explainAf: Die vuurdriehoek: brandstof, suurstof en hitte om die reaksie te begin.

items.q: Balance the equation: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. How many water molecules are needed to balance it?
items.qAf: Balanseer die vergelyking: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. Hoeveel watermolekules is nodig om dit te balanseer?
items.explain: Two H₂O molecules use 4 hydrogen and 2 oxygen atoms, matching the reactants: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.
items.explainAf: Twee H₂O-molekule gebruik 4 waterstof- en 2 suurstofatome, wat by die reaktante pas: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.

items.q: Methane burns: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O. How many oxygen atoms are on each side?
items.qAf: Metaan brand: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O. Hoeveel suurstofatome is aan elke kant?
items.explain: Left: 2 × 2 = 4 O atoms. Right: 2 (in CO₂) + 2 (in 2H₂O) = 4 O atoms, so the equation is balanced.
items.explainAf: Links: 2 × 2 = 4 O-atome. Regs: 2 (in CO₂) + 2 (in 2H₂O) = 4 O-atome, dus is die vergelyking gebalanseer.

items.q: A reaction in which a substance burns in oxygen.
items.qAf: ’n Reaksie waarin ’n stof in suurstof brand.

items.q: A reaction in which one substance breaks down into two or more simpler substances.
items.qAf: ’n Reaksie waarin een stof in twee of meer eenvoudiger stowwe afbreek.

items.q: A reaction in which two or more substances join to form one product.
items.qAf: ’n Reaksie waarin twee of meer stowwe verbind om een produk te vorm.

items.q: The gas that turns limewater milky.
items.qAf: Die gas wat kalkwater melkerig maak.

items.text: When a hydrocarbon burns completely, the products are carbon dioxide and [[]]. When there is not enough oxygen, poisonous carbon [[]] can form.
items.textAf: Wanneer ’n koolwaterstof volledig brand, is die produkte koolstofdioksied en [[]]. Wanneer daar nie genoeg suurstof is nie, kan giftige koolstof[[]] vorm.

items.text: Hydrogen gas burns with a squeaky [[]] sound. Oxygen relights a glowing [[]].
items.textAf: Waterstofgas brand met ’n [[]]-geluid. Suurstof laat ’n gloeiende [[]] weer vlam vat.

items.q: Rusting is a reaction of iron with oxygen and water.
items.qAf: Roes is ’n reaksie van yster met suurstof en water.
items.explain: True. Both oxygen and water are needed for iron to rust.
items.explainAf: Waar. Beide suurstof en water is nodig vir yster om te roes.

items.qAf: Om yster te verf, versnel roes.
items.explain: False. Paint keeps oxygen and water away from the iron, which prevents rusting.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Verf hou suurstof en water weg van die yster af, wat roes voorkom.

items.q: Heating copper carbonate to form copper oxide and carbon dioxide is a decomposition reaction.
items.qAf: Om koperkarbonaat te verhit om koperoksied en koolstofdioksied te vorm, is ’n ontbindingsreaksie.
items.explain: True. One reactant breaks down into two products.
items.explainAf: Waar. Een reaktant breek in twee produkte af.

items.q: Match each reaction in column A with its type in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke reaksie in kolom A by sy soort in kolom B.
pairs: Calcium carbonate → calcium oxide + carbon dioxide
Hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → sodium chloride + water

items.q: Explain why it is dangerous to burn a gas heater in a closed room.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom dit gevaarlik is om ’n gasverwarmer in ’n toe kamer te brand.
points: The oxygen in the room gets used up, so combustion becomes incomplete.
Poisonous carbon monoxide forms, which can cause unconsciousness or death.
pointsAf: Die suurstof in die kamer word opgebruik, dus word die verbranding onvolledig.
Giftige koolstofmonoksied vorm, wat bewusteloosheid of die dood kan veroorsaak.
